note: CC-AUG6-AUDITPASS F8 — the settings-truth manifest. Every RENDERED control maps to an entry here, and every entry names an observable effect plus the test that proves it. A switch with no effect test fails the build. `suppressed_by` exists because the Aug 6 audit's 'dead switches' were mostly NOT unwired — all 17 controls were connected. They were alive and overridden: extra attempts forced ON by Kid Mode, reminders forced OFF by Kid Mode. A control that a mode overrides must SAY SO here, and must render as overridden rather than as an ordinary toggle the player can move to no effect.

controls.effect: body.kid class; kid_filter applied to word selection; camera absent; Say It disabled; account entry points hidden; level selector rebuilt at once to the tiers experience::allowed_tiers returns (Spell Jr: Climb, Easy, Medium; Hard and Expert return when switched off)
controls.suppressed_by: age_locked (under-cutoff device: the switch is not rendered at all; the row offers the existing parent gate, labelled Ask a grown-up, instead — CC-ONBOARD-JR F5)

controls.effect: body.readable class
body.big-text class (1.5x scale)
state.rate 0.9 -> 0.55; server path sets playbackRate, native path maps via SpeechRate.avRate; same word's audio runs >= 1.25x longer
off: no word resolves to the 'human' provider, the router starts at the pack/server clip; on: a word with a verified bundled clip plays it (CC-HUMAN-AUDIO F6)
a missed word offers a second try
controls.was: kid — Kid Mode forced this ON via `s.extra_attempts || s.kid`, so the switch did nothing in Spell Jr. D8 (delegated to Claude, 2026-08-06): the preference is authoritative; Kid Mode now DEFAULTS it on instead of overriding it.

controls.state: localStorage spell_telemetry_opt_v1 (absent = edition default: on for consumers, off in Education)
controls.effect: CC-TELEMETRY-FOUNDATION F7: off stops every telemetry send and clears the local queue, aggregate and perf cells at once; on resumes. For a Jr or not-yet-answered player the switch snaps back and only the parent gate can change it
controls.suppressed_by: the server kill switch (spell_flag_telemetry_enabled = off): nothing is sent whatever the switch says, so it renders disabled

controls.effect: notifications::apply schedules/cancels the daily reminder
controls.suppressed_by: kid — Kid Mode suppresses the daily reminder (`remind && !kid`). DELIBERATE, but the row must render as suppressed in Kid Mode, not as a live toggle.

controls.effect: audio_boost gain node, 0.5-2.0; loopback RMS rises monotonically across slider positions
controls.caveat: the AudioContext is created lazily and only when a boost is requested (anti-fingerprinting). If unlock() has not run on a user gesture the context can be born suspended — the effect test must move the slider AFTER a gesture.
